AnswerKey.Name: DEFAULT
AnswerKey.ValidTrueComment:
The NetApp environment enforces administrator privileges based on defined roles.
The authorized AD groups and their mapped ONTAP roles are documented and validated against Section 9.3 of the NetApp System Baseline, Security, and Inventory (SBSI)
CyberARK PAM is implemented as the direct user-authentication intermediary, account and access management to USAICoE's Intelligence training networks, servers and systems. It provides MFA (token/encrypted password) for privilege users to elevate using a randomly generated encrypted OTP (not displayed to privileged users). CyberArk protects and tracks privileged accounts/users, with safeguards to reduce the insider threat by tracking intentional and unintentional malicious or negligent actions and prevent external threats/hackers from causing further network/system damage via network penetration by enforcing the principle of least privilege and data-at-rest with encrypted, hashed and salted passwords in deployment and in storage. References: STIG ID -V-246888, Regulatory resources NIST 800-63 Series AAL 1, 2 & 3, DOD, ARMY 25-2, Cybersecurity and ARCYBER directives.
